track2.method: Every eligible source coded from scratch by an independent coder blind to pass 1, using a different unit of analysis and a different causal vocabulary, then compared on passage overlap to characterise coverage. The seeded subsample the human track would draw is reported alongside, so the cost of the sampling rate is visible.
track2.coder2Kind: rule-based stand-in for the blind human coder

coverage.samplingNote: Coding every eligible source gives recall 31.3% over 32 independently identified accounts. The 20% subsample gives 0.0% over 1. The gap between them is the cost of the sampling rate, and it is the argument for choosing the rate from this number rather than by convention.
coverage.interpretation: Of 32 accounts the independent coder identified across all eligible sources, pass 1 also found 10. The 22 it missed are the coverage gap, and each is listed so it can be inspected rather than summarised away.
